title: Missing test for REQ-SYNC-011 safe-side revocation when member cannot be resolved
description: REQ-SYNC-011 specifies two cases for unknown status: (1) member resolved + existing role -> revoke (safe-side), (2) member cannot be resolved -> no role action. The test INT-SYNC-006 at webhook-flow.test.ts:189-206 only tests case 1 (member resolved -> revoke). There is no test for case 2 (unknown status with unresolvable member -> no role action). The implementation at webhook.ts:140-155 returns 'failed' with 'member_not_found' before reaching the unknown status check, which means case 2 is implicitly handled but not tested or verified.
recommendation: Add a test where the event has an unknown status AND the member cannot be resolved (both metadata and subscription_id lookups fail). Verify that the response is 200/failed and syncRole is NOT called.
